configurationExchange.exportHelp: Choose the records to include. A selected point includes its source. Mappings and value rules include their references.
configurationExchange.importHelp: Choose a JSON or XLSX configuration file to review its changes before saving.
configurationExchange.legacyHelp: SMA-004 backups can be restored here. Older single-collection JSON and XLSX files are merged into the current configuration.
configurationExchange.backupHelp: Full backups include the saved connection address. Select the address to enable this export.
configurationExchange.selectionEmpty: Select at least one record or the connection address to export.
configurationExchange.inventoryEmpty: The current profile has no exchangeable records.
configurationExchange.desktopRequired: Configuration exchange requires the SMA desktop app.
configurationExchange.redactionHelp: Credential values were removed. Review the listed fields and complete them locally before enabling affected sources, targets or mappings.
configurationExchange.readBusy: Reading and checking the selected file…
configurationExchange.previewEmpty: The preview has no configuration entries.
configurationExchange.restoreWarning: Restoring this backup replaces the full profile configuration. Review updates and deletions below.
configurationExchange.restoreConfirmation: Replace the current configuration with this backup

error.invalidWorkbook: The XLSX workbook is damaged or does not match the configuration format.
error.unsupportedVersion: This configuration file version is unsupported.
error.invalidHeader: The worksheet header does not match the required columns.
error.unknownSheet: This worksheet is not part of the configuration format.
error.unknownField: This field is outside the configuration format.
error.fieldType: The field is missing or has the wrong type.
error.duplicate: The file contains a duplicate ID or field.
error.missingReference: A referenced source, point, target or rule is missing.
error.tooLarge: The file, row count or cell exceeds the configuration format limit. Use JSON for large individual XLSX cells.
error.formula: Configuration worksheets only accept literal cell values.
error.unsafeWorkbook: The workbook contains a macro or an external reference.
error.invalidCell: The worksheet cell contains an invalid value.
error.credentials: Credential values were found. Remove them from the file before importing.
error.backupCredentials: The full backup contains a credential field. Use the filtered JSON or XLSX export to review fields to complete.
error.emptyFile: The file contains no selected configuration.
error.fileType: Choose a JSON or XLSX file.
error.stale: The configuration revision changed. Preview the file again.
error.busy: Wait for active collection and reporting to stop before saving changes.
error.conflict: The incoming identity conflicts with a saved record.
error.invalid: The configuration could not be loaded, checked or saved. Review the error code and file location.
